properties.markdownProperty:
A **Comment** is a specialised paragraph (classes *paragraph* and *comment*) for editorial notes, explanations, warnings or open issues that are *about* the document rather than part of its content. It is normally rendered in a distinctive style so readers can tell it apart from normative text.
**Traceability**
- *Can be traced from other objects:* **Yes**. It has the `traceable-object` class, so the *Dependencies* of other objects can point to it (it can also be the target of a symbolic link). - *Can have traces to other objects:* **Yes**, the same as a paragraph. *Authors* and *Sources* point to stakeholders, and *Dependencies* point to any traceable object, for example the requirement an open issue refers to.
Every section in this catalogue opens with a comment like this one.
